# Changelog

- On 2026-10-09, computer-use foundations Milestone 1 added the versioned 44-slot public-site manifest with 40 active tasks, 4 fixture deferrals, 28 fault rows, and a 10-fault smoke selection. It added HTTPS, redirect, permission, and `robots.txt` preflight; synthetic identities; serial low-rate execution; independent evidence scoring; atomic spend accounting; authenticated run-keyed fault controls; DOM and sandbox-controller fault adapters; and deferred-egress matrix reporting. Remote Bazel passed 4/4 targets, TypeScript passed 53/53, import-linter retained 12 contracts, `ty`, formatting, exact-head hooks, and `git diff --check` passed. The provider-free contract passed with `PASSED_WITH_DEFERRED_EGRESS` and $0 spend.

- On 2026-10-09, the computer-use foundations M1 smoke baseline executed 10/10 selected faults. DNS/reset and planted-secret protection passed; 8 expected baseline failures remained for main-document errors, redirect chains, DNS rebinding/private-listener evidence, stale references, delayed POST and exactly-once evidence, renderer crashes, sandbox kills, and parent cancellation. The aggregate matrix was `FAILED`, cumulative smoke spend was $0.15 against the $10 cap, cleanup found no matching sandboxes, and the retained baseline had 15 deferred egress rows. The approximately $75 full evaluation and a duplicate paid smoke run were not launched; computer use was not ready for speed experiments.

- On 2026-10-09, the computer-use fast-path benchmark ran three repeats of 24 tasks, totaling 72 lookups per arm. The fair combined arm matched baseline correct counts in each repeat (5/24, 4/24, and 4/24) while reducing median latency by 54.8%, p90 latency by 55.2%, large-model calls by 39.4%, and model-plus-sandbox cost by 65.9%. The result did not establish an accuracy-preserving speedup because overall accuracy was low; a one-repeat comparison showed a 4.6% median reduction, 41.7% p90 reduction, 34.3% cost reduction, 7.5% more large-model calls, and one fewer correct result. Guarded action batching was the strongest isolated arm, reducing median latency by 67.6%, p90 by 61.6%, and cost by 73.9%, with an accuracy increase from 18.1% to 29.2% that had overlapping confidence intervals. The oracle URL upper bound reached 75.0% accuracy but was not the headline comparison. The provider-valid action schema eliminated earlier harness `ValidationError` failures; the final 648 rows contained none. Of 37 incorrect rows, 33 were navigation failures; no provider exception or harness defect was found. The benchmark preserved the invariant that gates route page readiness but cannot finish a lookup, while deterministic evidence verification and a large-model result remain required.

- On 2026-10-09, PR #19561 merged into `main` as squash commit `95af7038e7` from approved head `b48ab466c9d6b5b56aa6685c91d78d76f9a7192a`. Its scorer rejects truncated or content-free trace exports, including `LIMIT`, `OFFSET`, and `FETCH` anywhere in the parsed AST, preserves run identity, runtime-predicate, and ascending-event-offset checks, and uses structural `pglast` validation. The merge preserved PR #19620 behavior and batches A and B; the catalog contains 58 unique entities, the generated query description matches the renderer, focused BuildBuddy validation passed 10/10 targets, and GitHub checks were green. The full description measured 118,263 characters, approximately 29,565 tokens, under the 45,000-token guard. Provider-backed evaluation was not rerun, and local pytest could not collect without generated protobuf modules.
